what: Equivalent trace noise of the Test streams that lock (PROTOCOL.md section 11, M4), computed as in scripts/probe_noise.py, and the uniqueness table (SYNTHETIC noise on real reference excerpts) read at that level by linear interpolation between the pre-set levels.
model: sigma = s * sqrt(1/r^2 - 1); s = std of the gap-filled reference over the excerpt's matched window [lock_index, lock_index + n_frames)
reading_A: r = r1 recorded by the frozen evaluation (results/search_cache/test; v2 weighted correlation)
reading_B: r = unweighted Pearson correlation of the same v2 trace with the same reference window
per_stream_rule: median over the stream's locking excerpts (one excerpt per length; a lock in the full or +-90-day scope)
